name: Pulseway
summary: Pulseway publishes no prices on its pricing page, which lists monitoring and alerting, remote control, patch management and scripting as core products. Security, ticketing and backup are sold as add-ons. Its pages offer a demo rather than a trial, so buyers must ask sales for a quote.

facts.text: Monitoring and alerting cover Windows, Mac and Linux, plus network devices and IoT.
Patch management covers operating systems and third-party apps.
Antivirus, ransomware detection, phishing defense, ticketing, IT documentation and backup are listed as add-on products.
Pulseway's home page offers a demo and a contact route but mentions no free trial.

plans.name: Quote
plans.notes: No prices are published on the pricing page

hiddenCosts: Security, ticketing, documentation and backup products are separate add-ons with no published price.
